scoring_justification: Checker recomputes λ3(t), λ1(t), η^∞, τ from the same analytic expressions (numerical integration + error functions) and compares to agent's submitted values; this is a direct recompute of the target quantities.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected Bloch vector components and derived constants recomputed from analytic formulas
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from the paper's analytic expressions (Eqs. 79, 84, 85, 88, and the integral form) for parameters α=1, g=1, β=5, Δ=0.5, μ=0.4.
hidden_assets.generation_method: The checker's prepare block computes expected λ3 and λ1 via scipy.integrate.quad and scipy.special.erf/exp1; no fixed gold numbers are embedded beyond the formulas and parameters.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are deterministically computed from the paper's own expressions; they are the standard reference values for these parameter conditions.

lambda3.description: longitudinal Bloch vector component at each time

lambda1.description: transverse Bloch vector component at each time

tau.description: decoherence time constant in units of 1/alpha

outputs.description: Agent-computed Bloch vector components and derived decoherence constants for the infinite-N limit at γ=0.

output_contract.notes: Scoring compares the reported values to hidden gold values with absolute tolerances; tolerances are not revealed here.
